text: また　たくさん　つれたけど　たたかう？

structure.jp: また　たくさん　つれたけど
structure.en: I hooked a lot again, so...

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど here is not a strong 'but'; it just sets up what comes before a question or offer. つれたけど = 'I've hooked some, so...'

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: つる 'to fish up' changed to つれる says something could be caught; つれた is its past. つれた = 'managed to hook'
